structured.answer: I'd go with Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track: it's the S&P everyone talks about, Harel is a name I know, the fee is 0.56%, it shows 13.7% over 3 years and 2.3 billion ₪ in it.

stuck.why: The 'מניות' row showed 24.04% for 3 years, much more than S&P's 13.7%; not sure why I shouldn't take the bigger one
'עוקב מדדים - גמיש' showed 26.39% and almost pulled me in, but I didn't know the word 'גמיש' or how well-known the company is
Endless rows that look the same, fees differ by hundredths of a percent; got bored and lost which company I was in because the company header had scrolled away
Looked for a recommendation or summary and found only 'עוד לא דווח' rows with warning icons

used: Harel row 'עוקב מדד S&P 500': 0.56%, 13.7% 3 שנים, 11.92% 5 שנים, 2.3 מיליארד ₪
Company group headers (הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב)
skimmed: Rows for other companies on screens 3–8
Exposure column with percentages and circles
Fund numbers in the קופה column
The last screen (flicked to the bottom)
skipped: Grey text at the bottom about returns before fees
unsure_meaning: פחות מ־3 שנים shown instead of a return
the ring/circle charts (guessed fuller = more shares)
not_found: A recommendation or 'start here' for a beginner
Fees in shekels for my amount
What to actually do first to open the fund
A side-by-side view of only the S&P tracks

findings.what: 143 near-identical rows with no recommendation or summary; a beginner can't choose and would rather do nothing
Fees only as small percentages (0.54% vs 0.56%), meaningless to me; no shekel amount for my money
Company name is only in the group header, which scrolls away, so mid-list I didn't know whose row I was looking at
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' or 'עוד לא דווח' instead of numbers, with warning icons that look scary
findings.where: Return and fee columns, especially the end of the list

findings.what: Wide desktop table layout, hard to use on a phone
Big return differences (24% vs 13.7%) with no explanation of risk, which pushes me to chase the highest number
Jargon like מט"ח, גמיש, ההפקדות with no plain explanation in view
